name: qamap
description: Turn PR changes into traceable local QA decisions and optional automation handoffs without an LLM call.

interface.shortDescription: Find what a PR needs to prove before merge.
interface.longDescription: Map commit and diff evidence to affected behavior, routed QA scenarios, and optional local automation without uploading source code.
interface.defaultPrompt: Analyze the current PR with QAMap and carry out the safest evidence-backed QA action.
